create_Losses: create a Losses instance with a predictor, specification, and PGD attack for interval bound propagation training
build_Losses__build: build nominal, verified, and attack losses in a Losses module given labels
build_Losses__build_nominal_loss: build natural cross-entropy loss and accuracy on clean data with optional label smoothing
build_Losses__build_verified_loss: build verified loss using interval bound propagation specification bounds with xent, hinge, or softplus loss types
build_Losses__build_attack_loss: build adversarial loss and accuracy metrics using a PGD attack on the predictor inputs
